[SWS_DM_00347] Channel identification in Indication
⌈
Uds Transport
Protocol implementation shall determine a distinct identifier to identify the network
specific channel over which the UDS request has been received, which can be later
used to deliver the UDS response to the source of the UDS request.
⌋
